faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Questions? We've got answers.
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before starting your content journey with Teleflow.

voice.question: Will the AI-generated content sound like me?
voice.answer: That's exactly what we built for. Teleflow analyzes your existing posts to understand your unique voice—your vocabulary, sentence structure, and what makes your content yours. The drafts feel authentic because they're based on how you actually write.

workflow.question: Do I have to leave Telegram to use this?
workflow.answer: Nope! Telegram is your idea inbox. Capture inspiration right where you are, and let Teleflow handle the organizing, drafting, and scheduling. You only visit the dashboard when you're ready to review, edit, or dive into your analytics.

billing.question: What happens if I hit my AI limit?
billing.answer: We'll let you know before you hit your limit. You can always upgrade instantly if you need more drafts, or wait until your next billing cycle. No surprise charges, ever.

team.question: Is this only for solo creators?
team.answer: Not at all. While solo creators love Teleflow, it's also perfect for content teams, agencies managing multiple channels, and media businesses that need a reliable, repeatable content system.
